```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r}
region_order <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  filter(year == 2025) |>
  arrange(desc(median_price)) |>
  pull(region)
```

```{r}
brf_lan_tidy <- brf_lan_tidy |>
  mutate(diff_pct = (mean_price - median_price) / median_price * 100,
    region = factor(region, levels = rev(region_order)))
```


```{r}
p <- ggplot(brf_lan_tidy, aes(y = region)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = median_price, xend = mean_price, yend = region, frame = year),
    colour = "grey") +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    x = median_price, 
    colour = "Median", 
    frame = year,
    text = paste(region,
           paste("Median:", median_price, "SEK"),
           paste("Mean:", mean_price, "SEK"),
           paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"),
           sep = "<br>")), size = 2) +
  
  geom_point(aes(
    x = mean_price, 
    colour = "Mean", 
    frame = year, text = paste(region,
           paste("Median:", median_price, "SEK"),
           paste("Mean:", mean_price, "SEK"),
           paste("Difference:", round(diff_pct), "%"),
           sep = "<br>")), size = 2) +

    labs(title = paste("title of my plot tbd is is very long what happens"),
    x = "Price",
    y = NULL,
    color = NULL) +

    scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(
    "Median" = "steelblue",
    "Mean" = "darkorange")) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "right")
````


```{r}
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") |>
  animation_slider(
    currentvalue = list(
      prefix = "Year: ")) |> 

animation_button(
    visible = FALSE
  )
```
